name: Ricardo Albuquerque
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began in the bustling karting scene of São Paulo, fueled by a childhood passion for racing and a natural aptitude for engineering. He quickly transitioned from driver to mechanic, honing his skills in race preparation and vehicle dynamics. His career progressed through various racing series, from Brazilian Stock Car to GT racing, where he gained invaluable experience in team management and logistical coordination.

As Head of Operations at JOTA Sport, Ricardo brings a relentless focus on efficiency and meticulous planning. He believes in empowering his team to take ownership of their responsibilities while maintaining a high standard of performance. His demanding nature is balanced by his creative problem-solving abilities, often finding innovative solutions to complex operational challenges. Ricardo's commitment to excellence and his ability to inspire those around him make him a vital asset to the team.

Ricardo is known for his unconventional approach to problem-solving, often drawing inspiration from seemingly unrelated fields. He is a staunch believer in continuous improvement and fosters a culture of learning within his team, always seeking to optimize processes and enhance performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with operational checklists and racing strategy notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every component before it is installed on the car.
